title: Night and Day: Diurnal Warming and Structural Change
abstract: arXiv:2607.00279v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper shows how the composition of local economic activity shifts decadally under diurnal warming (higher nighttime and daytime temperatures) within Indian districts (1981--2011). Warmer nights raise, warmer days lower agricultural wage-labour shares. Though warmer days and nights both contract grain production and area under cultivation, only warmer days raise local harvest prices. Long differences show the labour divergence is within the rural population. In towns, both margins depress non-agricultural worker shares. These results are consistent with a model where warmer days shock land and labour productivity, but warmer nights are land-biased shocks in agriculture.

translated_title: 昼夜：日间增温与结构变化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2607.00279v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：本文展示了在印度各地区（1981-2011年）昼夜增温（夜间和白天温度升高）如何使当地经济活动的构成发生十年尺度的变化。较暖的夜晚提高了农业工资劳动份额，而较暖的白天则降低了这一份额。尽管较暖的白天和夜晚都减少了谷物生产和种植面积，但只有较暖的白天会提高当地收获价格。长期差异显示，劳动力分化发生在农村人口内部。在城镇，两种增温都会降低非农业工人份额。这些结果与一个模型一致，其中较暖的白天冲击土地和劳动力生产率，而较暖的夜晚则是农业中的土地偏向性冲击。
tldr: 本文发现印度地区昼夜增温对农业结构产生不同影响：夜间增温提升农业劳动份额，而日间增温降低该份额，且只有日间增温提高收获价格，揭示了温度变化对经济活动的差异化作用。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that diurnal warming in Indian districts has opposing effects on agricultural structure: warmer nights raise agricultural labor shares, while warmer days lower them, with only daytime warming increasing harvest prices, revealing differentiated impacts of temperature changes on economic activity.
